title: Before the words
attribution: Aristophanes · "Before the words" (Thread). Questions from the Stanislavski–Knebel tradition and Uta Hagen's questions.

prompts.hint: Where you've come from, what you've just heard or learned.
The place, the hour, who else is here.

prompts.text: What do I want from them in this scene?
prompts.hint: In your own words. If it helps, start with "To…".
Who or what stops me getting it.

prompts.text: What is the event of the scene?
prompts.hint: What changes for everyone, from the start to the end.
